title: Repair an offline package incident and hand it over
goal: Independently select a compatible fixture version, restore verified content/config and leave unrelated packages untouched.
challenge: An old handover claims data 1.0, but inspect the installed pair rather than trusting it. Preserve header=handover-kept and the original configuration; reject the inappropriate upgrade with its exact refusal, recover the prepared damaged data to its supplied independent SHA-256, and produce the full expected unprivileged report. Keep prior damage evidence and unrelated package state; finish exact cleanup.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/rpm-recovery.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && umask 077; here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/rpm-recovery.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700; }; fresh() { here || return 19; test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test ! -e "$1" && test ! -L "$1"; }; cfg() { case "$1" in /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf|/etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmnew|/etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmsave) ;; *) return 19;; esac; here && test "$(realpath -e /etc/learning-lab-rpm)" = /etc/learning-lab-rpm && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a /etc/learning-lab-rpm)" = root:root:755 && test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1" && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a:%h "$1")" = root:root:644:1; }; keepcfg() { cfg "$1" && fresh "$w/$2" && cp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && cmp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$w/$2")" = learner:600:1; }; releasecfg() { cfg "$1" && test "${2##*/}" = "$2" && test -f "$w/$2" && test ! -L "$w/$2" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$w/$2")" = learner:600:1 && cmp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && sudo rm -- "$1"; }; h=/usr/local/sbin/ll-rpm-fixture; f=/opt/learning-lab/rpm-fixtures; here && test "$(df -B1 --output=avail / | tail -1)" -ge 1073741824 && fresh "$w/before.json" && sudo "$h" status > before.json && grep -F '"fixtures": {}' before.json && fresh "$w/before-raw.tsv" && timeout -k 1s 20s sudo rpm -qa --qf '%{NAME}\t%{EPOCHNUM}\t%{VERSION}\t%{RELEASE}\t%{ARCH}\n' > before-raw.tsv && fresh "$w/before.tsv" && LC_ALL=C sort before-raw.tsv > before.tsv && pwd
steps.explanation: Record this private path and shell definitions. A guard failure stops the exercise; do not continue over existing fixtures. Resume requires recorded path/definitions, not replaying setup.
steps.expected: Fixture-free package baseline retained without masking query failure.

steps.command: here && sudo "$h" apply pair && keepcfg /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf original.conf && cfg /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf && printf "%s\n" header=handover-kept | sudo tee /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf >/dev/null && keepcfg /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf edited.conf && fresh "$w/incident.txt" && printf "%s\n" "Old note claims data 1.0. Actual target: data 2.0-1/report 1.0-1." "Retain header=handover-kept and repair the approved damaged data." > incident.txt && cat incident.txt
steps.explanation: Create a misleading handover distinct from the upgrade lesson. The initial pair is compatible; inspect reality before choosing a repair.
steps.expected: Known original/edit; target versions independently stated.

steps.command: rpm_step() { here || return 19; fresh "$w/wrong-plan.txt" || return 19; if sudo "$h" preview upgrade > wrong-plan.txt 2>&1; then return 1; else test $? = 1 && grep -F "upgrade requires data1 only" wrong-plan.txt; fi; }; rpm_step
steps.explanation: An upgrade based on stale inventory is wrong for installed data 2.0. Retain the exact refusal.
steps.expected: No package changes; specific wrong-plan refusal.

steps.command: rpm_step() { here || return 19; test -f /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm/data.txt && test ! -L /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm/data.txt && test "$(realpath -e /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm)" = /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a:%h /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm/data.txt)" = root:root:644:1 && fresh "$w/verify-damaged.txt" || return 19; printf "%s\n" damaged | sudo tee /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm/data.txt >/dev/null || return 19; if rpm -V ll-rpm-data > verify-damaged.txt; then return 1; else test $? = 1 && grep -F /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm/data.txt verify-damaged.txt; fi; }; rpm_step
steps.explanation: Retain the deliberate package-owned damage evidence before repair. The expected independent data hash remains supplied.
steps.expected: Actual damage detected; owner configuration retained.

steps.command: here && sudo "$h" preview reinstall && sudo "$h" apply reinstall && cfg /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf && cmp edited.conf /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf && test "$(sha256sum /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm/data.txt | cut -d " " -f1)" = efcc5782abc5684c58caca66d0f23fbf64bc72109e4f937575ff834bb7c1cac4 && fresh "$w/report.txt" && fresh "$w/expected-report.txt" && /usr/bin/ll-rpm-report > report.txt && printf "%s\n" "Learning Lab package report" header=handover-kept "Learning Lab offline inventory" fixture_data_version=2.0 items=3 > expected-report.txt && cmp expected-report.txt report.txt && cat report.txt
steps.explanation: Repair only the approved payload while preserving the owner edit. Check actual unprivileged report output against full expected bytes.
steps.expected: Working correct-version report and independent content recovery.

hints: A valid signature/digest or zero transaction status alone is insufficient; do not invent complete RPM objective coverage.
Read supported helper operations and the exact plan before APPLY. Unsigned fixture digests do not prove publisher authenticity.
Verify versions, payload/config bytes and actual learner access; package exit status alone is insufficient.
review: I retained the requested actual output, statuses, versions and byte/access evidence, including the incorrect case.
I met the selected mode’s outcomes and can explain the limitations. Completion records self-review, not a score or verified assessment.
I preserved originals and retained candidates, compared unrelated package state and completed only the exact cleanup.
coverage: LPIC-1 active v5.0 partial 102.5 102.5 transfer; no claim of full objective or Zypper/YUM mastery. DNF4 awareness, not original YUM, DNF5 or Zypper proficiency. No complete-objective or LPI endorsement claim.
